one_line_contribution: A variance-components audit of per-item counterfactual credit in an ALFWorld experience bank: it estimates how much of the spread in leave-one-out item scores is real between-item signal versus re-run noise, separately for expert, self-written and planted-wrong items, and converts that decomposition into a reliability-versus-re-run curve, a winner's-curse retention rate and a re-run budget at which pruning beats random.
closest_prior_work: Data Banzhaf (arxiv:2205.15466, VERIFIED via s2cli paper: AISTATS, 196 citations) is the strongest threat: it already establishes that under a stochastic learning algorithm LOO and Shapley data values are dominated by run-to-run noise and rank unstably, and proposes the noise-robust semivalue. Its abstract's claim -- 'when the underlying ML algorithm is stochastic, the Banzhaf value ... robustly differentiate[s] data quality' -- is the same measurement insight one level up. It does not pre-empt the proposal: its noise is retraining stochasticity over supervised training data, it reports rank stability rather than a between-item variance component, and it never gives a re-run count for a target reliability. Two nearer-in-domain works, both VERIFIED: CUE-R (arxiv:2604.05467, cit 2) already does per-evidence-item REMOVE/REPLACE interventions to measure operational utility, but in single-shot RAG and with no variance decomposition or repeat-measurement analysis; and Source Attribution in RAG (arxiv:2507.04480, PKDD/ECML workshops, cit 7) already trades attribution fidelity against LLM-call cost for document-level SHAP, though its estimator error is coalition sampling on a fixed value function, not re-run noise of a stochastic agent. Also verified and cited correctly: 1904.02868, 2406.04606, 2305.19998 (which itself notes Shapley estimates are seed-sensitive), 2605.04811, 2606.16285, 2608.02508, 2607.22562, 2605.08374, 2607.21106. arxiv:2605.00944 (SCARV) could not be resolved by `s2cli.py paper` but was returned by an S2 keyword search with matching title, so I treat it as verified; nothing else in the proposal's novelty argument failed verification. Net: the question is under-asked in the agent-memory literature, but the machinery (variance components, Spearman-Brown, disattenuation, split-half) is entirely classical, so novelty rests on the domain, not the method.
strongest_objection: The headline null is close to forced by the chosen composition, and the proposal's own numbers say so. In C1 the HOLE set retains two correct same-type expert exemplars, so by the measured k-sweep any single helpful item's marginal is bounded by k3 - k2 ~ 4 net. If the entire attainable credit range for correct expert items is about 4 net, a between-item SD below 5 net is arithmetic, not a finding: P1 cannot fail except through actively harmful expert items, which the design neither plants nor controls. The pre-registered estimator gate does not repair this, because it certifies only that the estimator recovers the between-class E-vs-W spread -- a spread manufactured by planting harmful items -- and never that C1 can express within-class differences among helpful ones. A second, independent version of the same objection: the estimand is the item main effect averaged over a fixed 16-game panel, which deliberately averages out the item-by-game matching component, yet the group's own Measurement C shows k3 - static3 = +17.2 net, i.e. retrieval buys a great deal over three fixed exemplars -- evidence that which item meets which game matters a lot. Reporting 'no item-level signal' from a design that averages away the one component known to be large invites the reading that the null is an artifact of the estimand. The interlocking makes this worse rather than better: the entailment check flags P1, P4 and P6 as near-entailed, and P4/P5/P6 are plug-in functions of tau_S, sigma and the W-E separation computed on the same 200 halvings of the same cell, so seven predictions carry roughly two free parameters plus one class separation. P7(c) states no falsifier and tests a 0.3 threshold with SE 0.16 at 40 items.
what_would_fix_it: (1) Move P1's confirmatory scoring to C2, where the item is the sole same-type procedure carrier and the credit range is not capped at ~4 net; report C1 as the natural-composition secondary. (2) Add a within-class positive control with a known non-zero tau: plant a graded-quality ladder of expert items (full, truncated-at-the-key-step, verbose-but-correct, partially-wrong) so the estimator must recover a within-E spread it was built to detect before any within-E null is scored; a between-class E+W gate cannot license a within-class null. (3) Fit item, game and item-by-game as three variance components on the shared panel and report the matching component explicitly, rather than inferring it only from the seed-split-versus-game-split contrast; state the headline as a decomposition ('item main effect is X% of the retrieval residual over static3, matching is Y%') tied to the measured +17.2 net, which turns a possibly-forced null into a positive number. (4) De-interlock P4-P6: score them as residuals against the plug-in curve computed from the measured tau and sigma, with pre-registered discrepancy bounds, exactly as the entailment check suggests. (5) Raise backbone 2 to >= 32 paired re-runs per item and give P7(c) an explicit falsifier stated relative to the attenuation ceiling sqrt(R1*R2), not an absolute 0.3. With (1)+(2)+(3) this becomes a defensible borderline-to-accept measurement paper; as written the headline is not testable in the arm that carries it.
missing_baseline: A within-class graded-degradation positive control for expert items -- expert trajectories degraded along a known quality ladder (step truncation, verbosity padding, partially-corrupted procedure) and planted into C1/C2 so a known non-zero within-E tau must be recovered before tau_E ~ 0 is reported. Every control in the plan (pooled E+W gate, W-E separation, k3-vs-k0 backbone gates) is between-class; none establishes that the design can express within-class spread among helpful items, which is precisely what P1 claims to bound. Secondarily missing: a natural-retrieval (uncontrolled-panel) arm, since all estimates come from a retrieval-forced panel that is not the distribution any deployed scorer operates on, and the token-matched replacement arm bounds composition rather than retrieval frequency.
preprint_collision: No verified collision. The proposal's own check is one of the better ones I have seen in this round: it reports five queries with the channel that answered each, gives IDs for what came back, distinguishes verified from returned (it states that its 'Banzhaf' query did not return Data Banzhaf and that the id was confirmed separately with the paper command), and reports an empty result as empty rather than as evidence. Its gap is that it never queries the method's actual home vocabulary -- classical psychometrics: generalizability theory, variance components, Spearman-Brown, disattenuation -- which is where a collision for a reliability-of-item-value paper would live. My searches, all answered by channel (a), the s2cli command querying S2+HF; WebSearch was unavailable in this session and was not used: (i) 'between-item variance decomposition of counterfactual credit for retrieved memory items in LLM agents' --recent returned 2607.25659, 2607.21106, 2605.08374, 2603.21563, 2603.04549, 2606.24595 -- all scorers or credit-propagation methods, none measuring the variance of the score itself; (ii) 'how many repeated runs are needed for a stable per-item value rank split-half reliability of data valuation estimates' --recent returned 2602.07150 (On Randomness in Agentic Evals, VERIFIED, cit 7), 2603.29231, 2512.07795, 2511.19794, 2604.12843 (IRT for benchmark calibration), 2602.00521 (IRT reliability of LLM judges) -- the closest family: re-run variance and psychometric reliability are being applied to agent and judge evaluation at the arm level, but none to per-item memory credit, so this is a live and encroaching neighbourhood rather than a collision; (iii) 'Data Banzhaf noise-robust data valuation ranking stability under stochastic training' returned SCARV 2605.00944 and otherwise noise-robustness papers unrelated to data valuation, reproducing the proposal's reported miss; (iv) 'leave-one-out removal of individual in-context demonstrations variance of estimated example utility' returned 2604.05467 (CUE-R), 2406.04606, 2309.17310, 2605.26350 (When Correct Demonstrations Hurt) -- CUE-R is the nearest intervention-based per-item measurement and reports no variance components; (v) 'winner's curse regression to the mean when selecting top-scored examples under noisy evaluation' --recent returned 2607.08522, 2508.13144 (Signal and Noise), 2606.27997 -- selection-under-noise at the benchmark level, not the item level; (vi) 'generalizability theory variance components reliability of influence estimates signal-to-noise ratio of instance attribution scores' returned nothing on data valuation at all; (vii) 'do individual memory items differ in utility variance components ...' --recent and (viii) 'how many rollouts per memory item are needed before pruning beats random pruning ...' --recent returned no relevant hit. Two searches were empty of anything on the mechanism and are reported as empty. Recency is genuinely covered by (i), (ii), (v), (vii), (viii), all --recent, so I score novelty as real but modest -- the method is off-the-shelf psychometrics and the adjacent literature (2602.07150, 2604.12843, 2602.00521) is already carrying it into LLM evaluation.
